front_g_p6.claim_boundary_excerpt:
WHY THIS IS MACHINE-SPECIFIC: on a discrete GPU the host-to-device and device-to-host copies are NOT optional -- there is separate device memory and the data must cross it. On this machine there is none, so both copies can simply not happen. That is why it qualifies for P6 where the flat autotune landscape did not.
FAIRNESS CAVEAT, STATED PLAINLY: the CUDA-era arm copies on EVERY call, which is the NAIVE pattern. A competent CUDA programmer hoists the upload out of the loop and keeps data resident, and would not pay this 7x. So the honest claim is NOT 'Apple beats CUDA by 7x'. It is that per-call host<->device copying costs 7.17-7.44x on this operation, and that on unified memory the elimination is structural rather than something the programmer must remember to do.
The ADP is PROVISIONAL,
front_g_p6.constrains: Unified-memory copy elision is machine-specific. Discrete GPUs still pay host-device copies. That ceiling applies to any P6 idea whose mechanism is 'do not copy / keep resident' (expert-cache reuse).

front_g_p6_constraint.claim_boundary_excerpt:
WHY THIS IS MACHINE-SPECIFIC: on a discrete GPU the host-to-device and device-to-host copies are NOT optional -- there is separate device memory and the data must cross it. On this machine there is none, so both copies can simply not happen. That is why it qualifies for P6 where the flat autotune landscape did not.
FAIRNESS CAVEAT, STATED PLAINLY: the CUDA-era arm copies on EVERY call, which is the NAIVE pattern. A competent CUDA programmer hoists the upload out of the loop and keeps data resident, and would not pay this 7x. So the honest claim is NOT 'Apple beats CUDA by 7x'. It is that per-call host<->device copying costs 7.17-7.44x on this operation, and that on unified memory the elimination is structural rather than something the programmer must remember to do.
The ADP is PROVISIONAL,
front_g_p6_constraint.constrains: Unified-memory copy elision is machine-specific. Discrete GPUs still pay host-device copies. That ceiling applies to any P6 idea whose mechanism is 'do not copy / keep resident' (expert-cache reuse).
front_g_p6_constraint.numbers_omitted: FRONT_G_P6 result timings are Codex measurements; sidecar does not restate them

recovered_implementation.note: The 41-system sidecar already owned primitives, HWIR, FPGA goldens, and both Odysseys. This module maps Codex P6/P7 candidates onto them. It does not fork a parallel primitive list or an FPGA backend.
